notes.title: Challenge Mode, New Achievements + Patchnotes, Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello ISLANDERS![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got patch notes and a brand new challenge mode for you to try!
We also bring good news for Steam(Mac) players too!

The following patch notes are for build [b]#2f95a55d[/b] - check the game main menu top right corner to see what version you are on![/p][p][b]✅ This patch and new challenge mode is now live on Steam(PC), Steam(Mac), PlayStation and Nintendo.[/b][/p][p][b]⌛ This patch and new challenge mode is coming to Xbox within the next few hours.
✅ Steam(Mac) we did it - you are finally caught up to the latest patch! We’re super sorry about the delay, so thank you for your patience![/b]

[b]Patch notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed → Issues where not all buildings were included in the score calculation with cone shapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Issue where the island score indicator UI sometimes would be invisible when completing a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Issue where verdures placed on plateaus would not be visible after save/load.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Buildings placed with alternate facades reverting back to base facade after saving and loading a second time in sandbox mode.[/p][/*][*][p](Consoles) Fixed → Issue where not all buildings would grant a score when using the Precious boon.[/p][/*][*][p](Consoles) Fixed → Issue where score was not calculated correctly when undoing boons on Aurora islands.[/p][/*][*][p](Consoles) Packaged key art updated.

[/p][/*][*][p]Added → Challenge mode, 4 new ways to play the game![/p][list][*][p]A Short Journey[/p][/*][*][p]No Time To Dilly-Dally[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Trouble[/p][/*][*][p]Fully Stacked[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added → 6 new achievements/trophies to complete 🏆[/p][/*][*][p]Added → A delay before the screensaver is activated, the delay has been increased to 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added → Message prompt when starting a new highscore game to warn about losing progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Added → All previous patch changes to Mac, making it one to one with Windows.[/p][/*][*][p](Consoles) Added → Delay before the screensaver is activated increased to 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated → Credits with special thanks 💜[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]What is the new challenge mode?[/b]
Test your skills and see how you fare against the new challenges!
There are 4 new challenges available, these challenges are here to stay so you can retry them whenever you’d like. All 4 challenges feature a weekly and global leader board too. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519642/c2371243dc1f713a6de046d84c2fb67c9a15c134.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]A Short Journey [/b]For those of us who want to play ISLANDERS: New Shores but may have a busy schedule, this is a shorter condensed version to play! How high a score can you get within 3 islands?[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Time To Dilly Dally
[/b]You’ve got 30 minutes to score as high as possible, keep an eye on the timer at the top of the screen and prepare to play quickly! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Temple Trouble [/b]Build your city around placing your perfect temple, we have a high score temple placement so far of 1014 - we're keen to see what you all can do 👀[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully Stacked [/b]If you had a perfect start to the game, all the buildings and all the boons available, what would you place first? You can't earn more buildings or boons, so plan carefully! 
This challenge will always start in the desert biome. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519642/3659686dc8a4d557b2a50abb57b1e8c0c1d76979.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re ideally going to be adding more challenges with future patches, so let us know what you think to the challenges... [i]who knows what the next challenge will be[/i] 👀[/p][p]- ISLANDERS team 🏝️[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]❗Quick Update - Steam(Mac) Players

The team was made aware of an issue with players losing their high score progress once they updated the game. The issue was identified to Steam(Mac) players only, and has been fixed! ✅

[b]Steam(Mac) players please update your game, this should return your original high score run back to you![/b] 
(We're super sorry and really appreciate all the help to solve this asap - it won't happen again!)[/p][p]- ISLANDERS team 🏝️
[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes + NEW BIOME! Available… now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello ISLANDERS,[/p][p]We’ve got patch notes and a free content update!!![/p][p]The free content update is a brand new biome which is available to play… today! 
(check your platform for specifics)[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519642/778bd0f4adc085c087ae3eba697dc9deddf508ae.gif"][/img][/p][p]
The following patch notes are for build [b]#3c74912d[/b] - check the game main menu top right corner to see what version you are on![/p][p][b]✅ This patch and new biome is now live on Steam (Windows)[/b][/p][p][b]⌛ The new biome is live on all platforms, but the latest patch fixes and additions are coming to PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo later on today. (Fixes coming soon™️). 
⏳ Steam (Mac) is still pending previous patches, and will not receive the luminescent biome [/b][b][i]just[/i][/b][b] yet. We’re sorry about the delay, and are working to resolve this ASAP![/b][/p][p]Thank you in advance for your patience!

[b][u]Patch notes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed → issue where not all buildings would grant a score when using the Precious boon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Issue where score was not calculated correctly when undoing boons on Aurora islands.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added → Luminescent biome 🍄🌊🌙[/p][/*][*][p]Added → New Sandbox items from the Luminescent biome (“trees” & flowers)[/p][/*][*][p]Added → A delay before the screensaver is activated, the delay has been increased to 3 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b][u]What is the new biome?[/u][/b]
The new biome is called [b][i]Luminescent[/i][/b], inspired by Bioluminescence coastlines that light up the night!
In the new [i]Luminescent [/i]biome, you can find:
- New trees (giant mushrooms!)
- New flowers that glow (based on real flowers, Firefly Petunias!)
- New blooming trees (giant mushrooms with glowing spots!)
- A beautiful new biome that seems to be in a perpetual night 🌙
- The new biome is available in 4 colour variations, red, blue, green and purple.
Let us know what you think of the Luminescent biome, we hope that you all like it! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MUMRB5DuceA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b][u]Where are the monthly challenges?[/u][/b] 
We wanted to share a quick and honest update about post-launch content - especially Challenge Mode.[/p][p]As you may have seen, there have been some changes behind the scenes in the wider organisation, which have made things a bit trickier when it comes to planning out content updates. Team structures have shifted a little, and that’s had a knock-on effect on how quickly we can get things out the door.[/p][p]That said, We are still here, still excited, and still fully committed to supporting ISLANDERS: New Shores long-term. We’re doing our best to navigate the changes in a way that keeps the game and the community moving forward.[/p][p]Our hope is to roll out the first version of challenge mode in the next free content update, but we want to take this moment to ask: what kind of challenge experience do you [i]actually [/i]want? High-score hunts? Creative goals? We’re all ears. [/p][p]Drop your thoughts in the comments - we’re reading everything, and your input will help us shape what is next. [/p][p]Thank you so much for sticking with us! [/p][p]- ISLANDERS team, and Coatsink 🏝️[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello ISLANDERS - It's patch time! [/p][p]
We got all your feedback, bugs, suggestions, so we've been pretty busy! 
We wanted to get the first official patch out ASAP and we're hoping some of the hard hitters for bugs and feedback are addressed 🪲[/p][p][/p][p][i]The following patch notes are for build #[b]d0581a95 [/b]- check the game main menu top right corner to see what version you are on!
[/i]✅ [b]This patch is now live on Steam (Windows) 
⌛ This patch will go live on PlayStation and Xbox later today.
⏳ These fixes will be included in a later patch for Nintendo Switch and Steam(Mac) - [/b][i]thank you for your patience![/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed → Issue in a rising island generator where buildings placed on stones in the water would rise above the stones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Weekly leader board not being centred around users on PS5.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Blooming trees from using a blossom boon would not follow rising islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed → Issue where the building from using duplicate or bargain was not rewarded if it was your only remaining boon but still had at least 1 unopened boon pack in the bar.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added option to settings menu to use instant advanced tooltips on mouse hover.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to settings menu to use a persistent toggle for tooltips when playing with a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Added user option to enable hovering placed buildings in the world and get a tooltip with the building name (PC only).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the camera to tilt slightly vertically in Photo Mode, get those overhead shots![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519642/41e0be0b5fd4c24cd12c0d86e954164a0237c070.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Keep the feedback coming and share your thoughts on this thread, we read [i]everything[/i]! 
happy island hopping and have fun!

- ISLANDERS: New Shores team 🏝️[/p]

notes.title: Just 4 Days to Go – ISLANDERS: New Shores Launches July 10th!
notes.content: [h2][b]Four Days to Launch – Let’s Build Something Beautiful [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Hello ISLANDERS friends! [/p][p][/p][p]Can you believe [b]ISLANDERS: New Shores [/b]launches[b] THIS WEEK[/b]? On [b]July 10th[/b], the next chapter in our island-building journey sets sail, and we can't wait to push that big round red button! (It's a green square button, but it doesn't sound as impressive...)[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, we’ve been working hard on building something that feels fresh and new while keeping the heart of the original [i]ISLANDERS[/i] intact. We’ve shared the first demo (and then updated it thanks to your feedback!), revealed our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2368930/view/499449376025872694?l=english"]2025 Content Roadmap[/url], and connected with so many of you during Next Fest, streams, and community chats. Your ideas, feedback, and support have been a huge part of this journey - thank you![/p][p][/p][h3]So What’s New in [i]New Shores[/i]?[/h3][p]Whether you’re a returning player or jumping in for the first time, [i]ISLANDERS: New Shores[/i] expands on the original formula in exciting new ways:[/p][p][/p][p]🌋 [b]New Biomes[/b] – Discover six diverse biomes, each available in 4 vibrant colour variations. [/p][p]🏗️ [b]Over 40+ Building Types[/b] – With new scoring mechanics, line-of-sight bonuses, and more.[/p][p]🌤️ [b]New Weather Events[/b] – Including Stellar and Aurora, with gameplay perks and visual flair.[/p][p]📸 [b]Photo Mode[/b] – Spin, zoom, and filter your creations to capture the perfect moment.[/p][p]🎁 [b]Boons[/b] – New power-ups to unlock for smart strategic play.[/p][p]🎶 [b]Expanded Soundtrack[/b] – Over 75 minutes of music to build, relax, and vibe to.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Twitch Integration[/b] – Let your audience shape your build with votes and choices.[/p][p][/p][p]It's the cosy city-builder you remember - just with more surprises, more personality, and more ways to build your perfect island escape.[/p][p][/p][h3]Pricing, Bundles & Steam Discounts[/h3][p][i]ISLANDERS: New Shores[/i] launches on Steam for [b]$9.99 USD[/b].[/p][p]We’re offering a [b]10% launch discount[/b] for all players here on Steam during launch week. If you already own the original [i]ISLANDERS[/i], you’ll also see a [b]special loyalty discount[/b] when purchasing the bundle.[/p][p]No pre-orders here on Steam – just wishlist and jump in when it goes live! [/p][p]As for the bundles, we will have three new Steam packs designed for every type of player, from curious newcomers to die-hard fans. Whether you're after the originals, the extras, or the complete collection, there's something for everyone. Full details drop in just a few days. [/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to see what you build, what challenges you take on, and what peaceful little corners you carve out in your New Shores. Keep an eye out for dev streams, more content drops, and your chance to help shape the updates to come.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this beautiful, cosy little world.[/p][p]See you on launch day! [/p][p][b]Team ISLANDERS[/b][/p]

notes.title: You spoke, we listened - Try the new updated demo!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back ISLANDERS fans to a fresh updated demo![/b]
We took all of your feedback onboard from the 1st demo, and the devs have made multiple changes we think you’ll be pleased to see implemented into the new demo. 

[b]The demo is remaining open until ISLANDERS: New Shores releases (Summer 2025), keep your eyes peeled for exciting news coming soon… [/b]

[u]So, what has changed in the updated demo?[/u]
[b]Balancing Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fortune Teller: Score per building reduced from 3 → 2
[*]Aviary: Max score increased from 100 → 125
[*]Lumberjack: Penalty adjusted from -5 → -4
[*]Bargain: Count reduced from 2 → 1; penalty increased from 4 → 5
[*]Score Multiplier: 0.5 → 0.6
[*]Reroll Charges: 4 → 5
[*]Wisp: Score lowered from 5 → 4
[*]Nature Interaction: Increased from 2.5 → 3 score
[/list]
[b]UX/UI & Visual Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaced icon-based tooltips with default text (a highly requested change!)
[*]Slight UI color tweaks to improve score preview visibility
[*]Adjusted tint color to reduce confusion during illegal building placements
[*]Improved wall platform placement for smoother gameplay
[*]General polish and bug fixes
[*]If you’d like the images or text to be larger, check out the settings! You can decide how large you’d like the UI to be
[/list]
[b]Demo Specific Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]New island variations
[*]Larger islands
[*]Slightly extended gameplay (still limited to 3 islands!)
[*]New “Duplicate” boon introduced, replacing “Bargain”
[*]4 new buildings:
- Temple
- Harbour
- Verdure
- Guild Hall
[*]New gameplay element: 
- Sacred Rocks
[/list]
Don’t forget to follow us on social media for the latest information all things ISLANDERS: New Shores!
Reddit - [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ISLANDERS_NewShores/]/r/ISLANDERS_NewShores/[/url]
BlueSky - [url=https://bsky.app/profile/coatsink.com]@coatsink.com‬[/url]
TikTok - [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@coatsink]@Coatsink[/url]
YouTube- [url=https://www.youtube.com/@coatsink]@Coatsink[/url]
Twitter - [url=https://x.com/IslandersGame]@IslandersGame[/url]
Steam - Game news, updates, and information will always be posted via Steam!

[b]Thanks again for being part of the community and supporting our game [/b]💙
We’re looking forward to seeing your scores on the leaderboard - Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Play the ISLANDERS: New Shores Demo Now – Live for City Builder Fest!
notes.content:
🏝️ Hey everyone! 

We’re excited to share that [b]ISLANDERS: New Shores[/b] is part of the [b]Steam City Builder & Colony Sim Fest[/b], and we’ve got BIG news...

[b][h2]You can play the brand-new demo RIGHT NOW![/h2][/b]

[b]This is the first time players can get hands-on with ISLANDERS: New Shores[/b], and we can’t wait for you to try it. Whether you're a long-time ISLANDERS fan or discovering the series for the first time, this demo is your first chance to experience everything we’ve been building - pun totally intended.

[h3]Just some of what’s new in ISLANDERS: New Shores:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Islands[/b] - Explore majestic new island types. Volcanic peaks in the “Lava” islands, or the tranquil beauty of the “Fantasy” islands. 
[*] [b]Photo Mode[/b] - Capture and share your stunning island creations with customisable filters and a turntable camera.
[*] [b]Expanded Soundtrack[/b] - Enjoy 75 minutes of original music that sets the perfect mood for your building adventures.
[*] [b]Dynamic Scoring Systems[/b] - Master innovative scoring methods - such as line of sight, distance bonuses, and inter-island strategies - to enhance your gameplay.
[*] [b]Boons[/b] - Unlock single-use power-ups that give you unique tactical advantages as you progress.
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] - Streamers can now engage their audiences directly with interactive features built into the game.
[/list]
[h3]We Want Your Feedback![/h3]
Tried the demo? We’d love to hear what you think! Let us know what you enjoyed (or what could be better) by filling out our short survey here:

[url=https://2ly.link/25obm]ISLANDERS: New Shores Demo Feedback[/url].

[h3]Watch the Devs Play the Demo Live![/h3]
Want to see the game in action first? Head over to the ISLANDERS: New Shores Steam page where we’ll be displaying the stream throughout the festival. Come watch the Devs play, share their tips and tricks to getting the highest score, and insight into how they made the game! 

Thanks again for being part of this community - we’re so excited to finally share ISLANDERS: New Shores with you. Let us know what you think, and happy building! 💙

From our Island to yours, we hope you enjoy the demo.
[i]The Station[/i]

notes.title: ISLANDERS: New Shores Announced – A New Chapter in Tranquil City-Building!
notes.content:
Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores! 

Whether you're a longtime ISLANDERS fan or discovering the series for the first time, get ready to build, relax, and explore like never before!

ISLANDERS is all about effortless creativity and smart, minimalist strategy. It’s a city-building experience without the stress - no complex resource management, no overwhelming systems. Just beautifully generated islands, a carefully curated set of buildings, and the freedom to craft something amazing at your own pace. Whether you're chasing high scores or simply creating a scenic paradise, ISLANDERS delivers that perfect mix of calm and challenge.

With ISLANDERS: New Shores, we’re taking that philosophy even further! Expect more variety, more creativity, and more ways to play, all while keeping the same simple, satisfying charm that made the original such a hit.

Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368930/ISLANDERS_New_Shores/]HERE[/url]

[list]
[*] [b]What’s New?[/b]
[*] [b]Two Modes: [/b]High Score and Sandbox, each with separate saves
[*] [b]44 Unique Building Types & 7 Island Properties[/b] to shape your city-building strategy
[*] [b]50 Dynamic Island Generators[/b] offering endless variety with every playthrough
[*] [b]Photo Mode with filters[/b] and a turntable camera to capture your best builds
[*] [b]75 Minutes of Original Music[/b] to set the perfect atmosphere
[*] [b]Boons:[/b] One-time power-ups for clever tactical play
[*] [b]Advanced Scoring Systems[/b] that reward strategic creativity
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] for an interactive streaming experience
[/list]

[previewyoutube=8lAgsVJxyJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

This community has always been at the heart of [b]ISLANDERS,[/b] and we’d love to hear your thoughts as we get closer to launch. Thanks for being part of this journey - we’re so excited to share New Shores with you! 

Thanks for your support as always, 
The ISLANDERS Team
